vulnerability_analysis: The contract has an owner-only function setMaxWalletAmount(uint256 _maxWalletAmountPct) that sets maxWalletAmount = _tTotal / _maxWalletAmountPct. By calling this function with a denominator larger than _tTotal (e.g., type(uint256).max), integer division will result in maxWalletAmount = 0. This creates a denial-of-service condition where non-excluded wallets cannot hold any tokens.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxWalletAmount with type(uint256).max as the parameter to force maxWalletAmount to 0.
step_by_step_plan:
1. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the current owner address
2. Call TARGET.setMaxWalletAmount(type(uint256).max)
3. Verify that TARGET.maxWalletAmount() returns 0
